name: @weirdscience/dbx
description: CLI tool for provisioning MongoDB instances on remote VPS infrastructure

scripts.release: npm version patch && git push && git push --tags && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --generate-notes
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push && git push --tags && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --generate-notes
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push && git push --tags && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --generate-notes

author: mikedotJS
